title: 50/30/20 Budget Calculator
description: Split your take-home pay into needs (50%), wants (30%) and savings (20%), then compare with your actual spending.
howto: Optionally enter actual spending per bucket to see over/under.

faqs.q: What counts as needs vs wants?
faqs.a: Needs: housing, food, transport, insurance, minimum debt payments. Wants: dining out, hobbies, subscriptions, travel. Savings: emergency fund, investing, extra debt payoff.
Common in expensive cities. Aim to trim wants first, then look at bigger levers like housing or transport.
No — it is a starting framework. Adjust the split to your goals, e.g. 50/20/30 to save aggressively.
